Engine plugins

What each render plugin records

Every Fox Engine render plugin in mgsvtpp.exe: what it records, in what order, through which jobs, with which shaders, and under which conditions, including paths no capture took. The tree on the left is the runtime plugin hierarchy for the main view, in run order; the numbers are the job-tree stages each plugin records.

  • records a stage or job in the captured tree
  • records nothing there
  • inline step
  • job step
  • devinferrednot read in the retail decompile

Read from the community decompile database, whose retail build sits at the installed executable's addresses; names are matched from a 2015 development build. Unmarked claims were read in the retail decompile; dev means seen only in the 2015 decompile, and inferred means not read. A shader that ran executed in that probe capture; not in captures means no capture bound it, not that it cannot run. Turn on evidence addresses in the top bar to see where each claim was read. The readers wrote their branch and capture notes against the hillside and ACC captures only; the ran marks on shaders cover every capture in the render map.

A viewport enables plugins by category, so the category decides which plugins a secondary view runs: 0 debug primitives, 1 scene, 2 primitives, 3 post-processing, 4 2D, 5 setup and callbacks, 6 sky and fog. The rain occlusion view enables only category 4, which is why it runs just the 2D plugins.

PluginStagesWhat it records
Geometry
GLOBAL_VOLUMETRIC_FOGPluginGlobalVolumetricFog1Draws the fog-volume atlas inline at the start of the frame and publishes the fog parameters that later passes bind.
DEFERREDPluginDeferredRendering1Clears the G-buffer, reserves the four deferred-model layer packets, then runs the geometry, AO, and shading children.
TERRAIN_DRAW_DEPTHPluginTerrainDepth1Terrain depth prepass, one job per terrain object.
OPAQUE_PASSPluginDeferredGeometryOpaque1Deferred-model layer 0: one job node for opaque materials. ALPHA_MODEL launches the job that records it.
MASK_PASSPluginDeferredGeometryMasked1Deferred-model layer 1: one job node for masked materials, recorded late like the opaque layer.
DEFERRED_CLONEPluginCloneDeferred1Clones in two jobs: single clone objects, then instanced clone streams.
TERRAIN_DRAWPluginTerrain1Terrain G-buffer materials, one job per terrain object, plus an overlay-wire job when a terrain has one. Skipped when viewport flag bit 18 is set.
DECAL_PASSPluginDeferredGeometryDecal1Deferred-model layer 2: model decals in one job node.
DECALS_DEFERREDPluginDecal1Six decal jobs split by type and by material, one terrain-decal job per terrain, then decals projected onto models.
DEFERRED_CLONEDECALPluginCloneDeferred1The clone plugin with a decal type set: clone decals in one job.
DEFERRED_RAWDECALPluginRawDecal1Raw decals in one job; vehicle skid marks draw here.
Depth, motion, and ambient occlusion
GEOMETRY_PASSPluginDeferredGeometry2–3Binds the G-buffer for its ten children, then ends the pass: half-resolution depth, object motion vectors in two jobs, and camera motion.
MATERIAL_LAYERPluginMaterialLayer2Draws registered material layers into the G-buffer inline. The rain wetness layer is the only one; in rain it draws at the start of stage 2, reading the rain view's depth capture.
LINEINTEGRAL_SSAOPluginLineIntegralSSAO3Line-integral SSAO at half resolution: occlusion, X and Y blur, upsample. Hands its texture to SHADING_PASS.
AMBIENTOBSCURANCE_SSAOPluginAmbientObscuranceSSAO3Ambient-obscurance SSAO: a pixel-shader pass, two compute blurs, and a compute upsample that keeps the minimum of both AO results.
SHADING_PASSPluginDeferredShading3, 9Begins the light-accumulation target, runs the lighting children, then draws the deferred composition the game selected: rain filter, TPP tonemap with fog, or the native shader.
PLUGIN_SPHERICALHARMONICSPluginSphericalHarmonics3–7One recording across stages 3 to 7 with four jobs: static sphere maps, dynamic sphere maps (always empty), SH volume blending, and dynamic SH lights. Ends with the sky light encode.
Ambient and local lights
LOCAL_LIGHTSPluginLocalLight7Ends the half-resolution light buffer it shares with SH, then always branches two jobs: unshadowed lights, and shadowed lights, which builds four nodes per light.
Sun, composition, and sky
SUN_SHADOWPluginShadow8Clears the 2×2 cascade atlas, then branches twelve jobs: opaque, alpha-tested, and terrain casters for each of four cascades.
SUNLIGHTPluginSunlight9One full-screen draw per enabled directional light. The shader is chosen by the light's diffuse, cascade-shadow, and environment-specular bits; shadowed lights add a stencil box over the largest cascade.
SUBSURFACE_SCATTERPluginSubSurfaceScatter9Skin scattering: copies the light buffer, then horizontal and vertical compute blurs.
SKYPluginSky9One full-screen sky draw with the material the atmosphere system picks: Sky_Draw_Tpp, its baked variant, or NoSky.
ALPHA_MODELPluginAlphaModel9, 11Forward-shaded models as deferred-model layer 3, in one job. Its last exec slot launches the recording jobs for all four layers.
Reflections and transparent effects
LOCAL_REFLECTIONPluginLocalReflection10Native screen-space reflections, all inline: scene copy, receiver mask, trace in one of four variants, a five-level blur pyramid, and the composite. Captured with the generic trace at Mother Base and the TPP trace in the sortie menu.
PRIMITIVESPluginPrimitive10–11Particles, water, ocean, and other primitives in two jobs, with the scene copy for refraction recorded inline between them.
THERMOGRAPHYPluginThermography11Thermal-vision models. Mode 2 (night-vision goggles, collectible indication) is one effects job; mode 1 (gimmick markers) is a plain model job.
Post-processing and UI
POSTFILTERPluginPostFilter13Post-processing parent: binds defaults, runs its five children, then copies the scene and draws the late pass, Tonemap or, with tonemapping off, ColorCorrection.
TONEMAPPluginTonemap12Exposure measurement and adaptation, then bloom: X4 reduction, bright pass, lens flare, and a Kawase blur whose pass count follows the bloom size.
DEPTH_OF_FIELDPluginDepthOfField12Depth of field by one of four paths: scatter, gather, near-only simplified, or off. Cutscenes bypass the user's setting.
DRAW2D_SHRINKPlugin2DShrink12–13Half-size 2D in one job, composited at the start of stage 13. Rain droplets on the camera draw here.
MOTION_BLURPluginMotionBlur13Tile-based motion blur. Its InitRender also turns on GEOMETRY_PASS's velocity pass for the frame.
COLOR_CORRECTIONPluginColorCorrection13Blends up to four color-grading LUT layers and binds the result for the late pass. Every capture ran one blend: two texture LUTs on the hillside, the ACC, and the sortie menu, and a texture with a generated LUT at Mother Base and in rain.
FXAAPluginFxaa13Copies the scene, then draws FXAA into the primary target.
OVERLAY_MODELPluginOverlayModel13Overlay models such as target markers in one effects job, branched even when there are none.
PRIMITIVES_UNFILTEREDPluginPrimitiveUnfiltered13Primitives drawn after post-processing, in two jobs. It forces the exposure constant to 1 and does not restore it.
DRAW2DPlugin2D13HUD, menus, and screen filters in one job, branched even when empty. In rain it also draws the shelter depth capture in the separate rain view.
PRIMITIVE_DEBUGPluginDebugPrimitive13Debug primitives in two jobs, the same recording as PRIMITIVES.
DRAW2D_FRONTMOSTPlugin2DFrontmost13Front-most 2D objects in one job, branched even when empty. It also runs, empty, in the rain view.
Nothing in the captured tree
VIEW_CALLBACKPluginViewCallback–Calls the per-view callbacks that scene objects register. No draw in any capture comes from it.
MODEL_SETUPPluginModelSetup–CPU work only: once per scene each frame it stores the camera position for model setup.
OCCLUDERPluginOccluder–CPU occlusion culling jobs against the scene's occluders. Records no commands.
PRECOMPUTE_SKYPluginPrecomputeSky–Rebuilds the atmosphere's precomputed sky and sun tables when the sky state changes, at most once a frame, and copies the tonemap key value into the atmosphere. No capture frame drew from it.
WORMHOLEPluginWormhole–Fulton wormhole models: an inline half-resolution scene copy and one effects job, only when such objects exist.
OPTICAL_CAMOUFLAGEPluginOpticalCamouflage–Optical camouflage models: a half-resolution scene copy and one effects job, only when such objects exist.
SCREEN_CAPTUREPluginScreenCapture–Photo and screenshot capture: target copies and a CPU readback while a capture is active, nothing otherwise.

Plugins

Frame

Build, kick, and display encode

Render::BuildRenderingALL, buildRendering, KickRenderingALL

Render::buildRendering 0x1401beec0 runs plugin list 0 once, the per-view list for each viewport, then list 1 once, and ends with DgDx11::EndRender, which draws the display encode. The kick then submits the whole tree.

Slots are vtable offsets. RenderPlugin::_Exec 0x1401bed80 calls +0x38, +0x40, ExecChildPlugin, +0x50, +0x48 (read). The database names the +0x48 function 'PostExec' and plugins.json files it under 'EndExec'; this file calls +0x38 PreExec, +0x40 MainExec, +0x48 PostExec(last), +0x58 SkipExec, +0x30 InitRender, and quotes the database name where it differs.

Cross-cutting notes

ambient ssao sh

  • Stages 3-7 are one recording sequence on the build thread split by the four Dg+0x560 calls in RegisterDrawOnJob: node22 inline (velocity, line-integral AO, obscurance AO, SHADING_PASS clear, StartSphereMap) -> node23 job#1; node24 inline (atlas copy) -> node25 job#2 empty; node26 inline (Start clears) -> node27 job#3; node28 inline (occlusion clear) -> node29 job#4; node30 inline (SH End + LocalLight LACC end) -> local-light jobs. Node numbers match observed-shaders.json.
  • AO chain: line-integral writes RT 0xd944204b8e96 and attaches it to SHADING_PASS+0x68; obscurance reads that texture as liaoBuffer, writes min(liao, SAO) to RT 0x84895a062e9d and re-attaches; composition samples t13. With PluginSao off (exe default) the composition samples the line-integral result; both off -> WHITE.
  • Graphics-setting gates are RenderPluginSettings Lua tables: 'PluginSsao', 'PluginSao', 'PluginSubsurfaceScatter' (EnableFilter, FadeOffset), 'PluginSphericalHarmonics' (DrawSphericalHarmonicsMaxCount, RejectionLengthBias).
  • Dg+0x298 (PerformanceEventEnd) is the empty ProgressFunc stub in retail, so markers have begins only.
  • Correction to stage names: stage 6 'SH occlusion' volumes are dynamic SH light probes (SetDynamic), drawn with the Occlusion shaders; stage-7 BilateralUpscale2x2 belongs to PluginLocalLight via the LACC manager; ShaderPoolManager::SetupShader only preloads DR_* shaders, selection is in DeferredRenderingControl.

forward effects

  • Top-level order (historical runtime tree; priorities are data, observed tree agrees): DEFERRED (lighting) -> SKY (inline) -> ALPHA_MODEL (1 job) -> WORMHOLE (copy + job, only with objects) -> LOCAL_REFLECTION (inline only) -> PRIMITIVES (2 jobs) -> OPTICAL_CAMOUFLAGE (copy + job, only with objects) -> THERMOGRAPHY (job when enabled) -> POSTFILTER -> FXAA -> OVERLAY_MODEL (1 job, always) -> PRIMITIVES_UNFILTERED (2 jobs) -> DRAW2D -> PRIMITIVE_DEBUG (2 jobs if active) -> DRAW2D_FRONTMOST -> SCREEN_CAPTURE.
  • Stage corrections: stage 9 job 0 is ALPHA_MODEL's layer-3 forward-model job (all forward models, not only sky objects). Stage 10 inline is LOCAL_REFLECTION; stage 10 job is PRIMITIVES pass A (every primitive without flag 0x800, including FourierOcean and mirror surfaces, not only lit particles). Stage 11 inline is PRIMITIVES' scene copy (plus Downsample/StartShrinkBuffer when enabled); stage 11 job 0 is PRIMITIVES pass B (0x800 primitives plus bit-56 model primitives, half resolution when shrink is on); stage 11 job 1 is THERMOGRAPHY. Stage 13 job 0 is OVERLAY_MODEL, jobs 1-2 are PRIMITIVES_UNFILTERED.
  • Command-node bookkeeping matches code: CommandListNode::Branch 0x1402c7c50 (recorded node -> new child + new continuation) vs Split 0x1402c80b0 (empty node handed to the job). Plugins whose pre-job work only changes state (ThermographyRenderingDx11::Start, PrimitiveRenderingDx11 pre-branch with no copy) produce sibling jobs in the same observed stage.
  • Shader technique types: "Forward" (ALPHA_MODEL, OVERLAY_MODEL, ForwardRendering), "Primitive" (all three primitive plugins; model materials drawn inside the primitive job use this technique, matching the *_prim shader variants), "Default" (OpticalCamouflage, Wormhole, Thermography backend). DgDx11::Branch copies the current technique index and default shader into each sub-context.
  • Scene-colour copies in this group: LOCAL_REFLECTION (CopyResource primary -> replica before the trace), PRIMITIVES and the other primitive plugins between their two passes (same CopyResource, gated by isEnableResolveRenderBuffer), OPTICAL_CAMOUFLAGE/WORMHOLE (CopyRenderBuffer to half-res TEMPORARY_HALF_RGBA32_0). On DX11 the depth "replica" is the primary depth target itself (+0x108 resolve is a ret stub).
  • Native LR chain: Mask -> one of four traces -> 5-level Gaussian/HalfDownSample pyramid -> CopySubresourceRegion into a 5-mip texture -> LocalReflectionAddBuffer. LocalReflectionComposite 0x93B69040, LocalReflectionBlurRoughness 0xA8529A23 and the LR CopyRenderBuffer slot are created but never bound in retail; they are not missing from the captures.
  • Ocean placement: FourierOceanManager primitives (desc flags 0x2/0x102, base 0x200212; Primitive_TppFourierOceanFill/HQ/LQ) land in PRIMITIVES pass A (stage 10 job) and register a PrimitiveDepthTargetReferrer (no copy on DX11). TwentyFourHourOcean surface (flags 0x201a82, includes 0x800; Primitive_Tpp24hOcean, material t1 = backbuffer copy, t0 = OceanWaveViewport sub-viewport texture) lands in pass B (stage 11 job 0); its base board (0x200212, Primitive_TppBaseOcean) in pass A. MirrorReflection2 (flags 0x12, Primitive_TppMirrorSurface, sub-viewport texture) lands in pass A.
  • PRIMITIVES_UNFILTERED overwrites the exposure constant 0x172 with 1.0 in its PreExec and does not restore it; whether a later plugin rewrites 0x172 before the next view was not checked.
  • Lua toggles with no rendering effect in retail: GrTools.SetEnableLocalReflection (unread global) and GrTools.SetEnablePrimitiveShrinkBuffer (stub).

forward lighting

  • Scope: everything drawn after deferred composition (the sky, ALPHA_MODEL forward models, both PRIMITIVES passes and the effect plugins) lights itself in its own pixel shader. None of it is in the G-buffer, so the deferred lights, shadows, SSAO, the spherical-harmonic ambient pass and screen-space reflections do not touch it. Skid marks are the exception: TppSkidmarksDecal 0x3A6D7D16 writes three targets, so they are G-buffer decals and are lit with the scene (shader assembly).
  • Constant numbering: the engine sets a shader vector by an index equal to (float4 slot << 4) | constant-buffer number. 0x03 and 0x13 are cb3 m_lightParams[0] and [1], 0x23 to 0x73 are m_lightParams[2..7], 0x83 is m_lightParams[8], 0x95 and 0xa5 are cb5 m_localParam[0] and [1], and 0x172 is cb2 m_exposure (slot 23). Checked against fox::gr::PluginAlphaModel::PreExec 0x1401cf7b0, which writes indices 3 and 0x13, and against the shaders' constant-buffer layouts.
  • Per-object light for forward shaders: fox::gr::LightSearchService::createLightParams 0x1402281e0 builds one record per object (model, primitive, river) and fox::gr::dg::ApproximatedLight::SetLightSearchResult 0x1402df000 turns it into cb3. m_lightParams[0] = (up - down) * 0.5 and [1] = (up + down) * 0.5, where up and down are the object's spherical-harmonic light evaluated straight up and straight down and clamped at zero. [2..7] hold at most three local lights as unshadowed point lights (position with attenuation, then color); spot lights are attenuated at the object and passed as points; unused slots are zero. The constants 0.5, 0.282095, 0.244301 and 0.315392 were read from the executable's data.
  • Where up and down come from: the search blends up to three fox::gr::dg::SphericalHarmonicsLightSource probes by GetWeightAtLocation at the object's position; with none in range it uses the global light of type 4, the sky's spherical harmonics. An object with no light record gets the frame default that PluginAlphaModel::PreExec sets: [0] = 0 and [1] = 0.25 gray (executable data at 0x1420F4E80 and 0x1420F4EA0). So forward surfaces get the same authored probes as the deferred scene, reduced to two colors per object, with no occlusion and no bounce light.
  • How shaders use the per-object light (shader assembly): forward models compute ambient as m_lightParams[0] * N.y + m_lightParams[1] (fox3dfw_lambert, fox3dfw_glass_*). Lit particles use [0] + [1] with no normal, which is the up color alone, and add the sun without an N.L term. Rivers read [0], [1] and the shadow fade [8] and no point lights. The Fourier ocean reads only [8]. Primitive_Liquid2Final reads two point lights and Primitive_TppFxRain_Boost three.
  • Sun for forward shaders: fox::gr::dg::DirectionalLightSource::SetShaderParametersForForward 0x14026e7b0 (models) and SetShaderParametersForPrimitive 0x14026e8e0 (primitives, direction negated) write the direction and color into cb5 m_localParam[0] and [1] and the shadow fade into cb3 m_lightParams[8]. Forward models sample one shadow cascade with a single comparison tap; the _EX particle variants choose between two cascades.
  • Reflection cubes come from four places. Forward glass (fox3dfw_glass_commonref*) and the glass-shard particles read the scene reflection cube g_ReflectionTexture at t11, bound once per frame in PluginAlphaModel::PreExec from SceneReflectionParameter::GetReflectionTextureHandle; it is an authored file chosen per area by ReflectionSettingBody, trap callbacks or the weather script (SceneReflectionParameter::SetReflectionTexture 0x140258460). Each river names its own cube in level data (cubeMapName in PrimRiverModelParam::RegisterEntity 0x1406e41e0); the marsh has cubeMapPath. Liquid splashes and Boost rain use one fixed asset, /Assets/tpp/effect/gr_pic/gr_cub01_ks_cbm_nmp.ftex. The oceans use no cube: their reflection is built from constant colors in the shader, scaled by the sun color.
  • Fog for forward shaders: every forward shader that fogs itself samples the same 512x256 RGBA16F image at t12 that deferred composition uses, written once per frame by VolFog_TppVolFog 0x99BEE81F. It holds 128 depth slices as 32 columns by 4 rows of tiles, so each slice is 16 cells wide and 64 tall. The slice index is saturate(invLogFarDistance * log2(view depth)) * 127 and two neighboring slices are blended. Tiles are addressed by fixed fractions (steps of 1/32 and 1/4 with a half-cell inset), not by texel counts (shader assembly of fox3dfw_constant_srgb 0x6CA8AA97; size, format and writer from eight captures). The image is analytic height fog with no shadow-map input, so it cannot produce light shafts. Particle shaders fog only in their _VF variants.
  • Which meshes are forward: ModelPacketRenderControlBase::GetRenderState 0x14025ef50 accepts a mesh for a layer when ((flags ^ control+0xf0) & control+0xf4) == 0. The alpha (forward) layer's control holds 0x410 in both, so a mesh is forward when its per-mesh flag word has bits 0x10 and 0x400 set; the opaque control excludes 0x690 and the masked one 0x600. Flag bit 0x8000 moves a forward mesh into PRIMITIVES pass B so it sorts with particles. The flag word sits at +0x20 of each 0x30-byte mesh entry of the model resource and appears to be baked into the asset (inferred).
  • Which pixel shader a forward mesh uses: the material names a technique; the Lua table read by GrTools.SetShaderAssignTable 0x140200720 assigns each technique a shader per shader type, and ALPHA_MODEL selects type Forward while PRIMITIVES selects Primitive. So fox3dfw_* shaders are a technique's Forward entries and *_prim its Primitive entries; a technique without one falls back to ModelForward. The table is game data.
  • Primitive passes: PRIMITIVES records pass A before the scene copy and pass B after it. A primitive goes to pass B when its flags have any of 0x7000 (Primitive::Initialize then sets 0x800). Pass A holds the Fourier ocean, the marsh, the cloud dome, infrared beams, the mirror surface and lit particles whose opaque property is set (alpha-tested and depth-writing). Pass B holds rivers, the 24-hour ocean, sorted particles, liquids, heat haze, sand wind, footprints, foot shadows and the fire scorch decals. Only pass B shaders can refract the scene copy. The flag values were read in the decompile; the pass of each effect is derived from them and matches the captures.
  • Particle shader suffixes (the fox::fx pool of 86 built by fox::fx::ShaderPoolManager::SetupShader 0x141b1fa40; shader assembly compared pairwise): _VF adds fog from the fog image and is chosen when the scene's volumetric fog is on; _DL is dynamic luminance, where the vertex shader divides an authored brightness by the exposure so the sprite keeps its on-screen brightness; _NS receives no sun shadow; _EX chooses between two shadow cascades and is used at effects quality 2; TA blends flip-book frames; DP1, DP2 and DP3 are the sun plus one, two or three point lights; LitD_Fast is ambient plus sun.
  • Rivers (shader assembly of Prim_TppPrimRiverTlHnmRpl 0x923A5659 and Prim_TppRiverModelShHnmRpl 0x66C42673): the reflection is the river's cube times Fresnel 0.05 + 0.95 (1 - N.V)^5, tinted by a desaturated sun color and by a weather color that PrimRiverModelManager::Update 0x1406e5270 sets each frame: (1, 1, 1) when clear, (0.30, 0.20, 0.04) in a sandstorm and (1.0, 0.7, 0.6) otherwise. It is then multiplied by saturate(1 - Fresnel + shadow), so in the sun's shadow the reflection fades exactly where Fresnel is strongest. The view through the water is a refracted fetch of the scene copy blended by depth, added without a 1 - Fresnel factor.
  • Oceans (shader assembly): Primitive_TppFourierOceanHQ 0xBA3880D3 builds its sky reflection from constants between (0.06, 0.105, 0.195) and (0.135, 0.22, 0.28) scaled by the sun color, with ambient = base color * (0.096, 0.2, 0.38). HQ samples the sun shadow and the scene depth (shoreline); LQ and Fill do not. The sun color comes from ocean::GetDirectionalLightColor, set by WeatherClimateUpdator::Update 0x1406b96e0 from the atmosphere's sun color. Primitive_Tpp24hOcean 0x51BA0392 uses the same constant-color approach and adds a refracted scene copy.
  • Sky: baked atmosphere data stores, per time sample of an 86400-second day, ten half-float RGB entries, read as nine spherical-harmonic coefficients and one sun color (the 9 + 1 split is inferred from the stride). SkyDrawer::Update 0x1407cb350 picks Sky_Draw_Tpp, Sky_Draw_TppBaked or Sky_Draw_TppNoSky. Generative clouds are a ray-marched model material driven every frame by GenerativeCloudsManagerImpl::Update 0x140737d70 (wind scroll, weather clock, light from the light search).
  • Emissive forward models: the fox3dfw_constant_* shaders are unlit (texture times material color times exposure, then fog). The Mother Base night capture has 340 such draws, consistent with lamps, signs and screens (use inferred from the captures). They are visible light sources that exist only in the forward pass, so nothing in the deferred scene receives light from the mesh itself.
  • Fakes drawn as primitives (shader assembly): Primitive_TppFootShadow is an unlit blob under each character's feet, a stand-in for a contact shadow; Primitive_TppFootPrint and Primitive_TppHeatHaze modify the scene copy; optical camouflage refracts a half-resolution scene copy; Primitive_TppSandWind lays a lit sand layer over surfaces using the G-buffer normal.
  • Correction to an earlier reading: Primitive_Liquid2Final and Primitive_LiqSprt2Final use two point lights, not three (they read cb3 m_lightParams[2..5]).

frame gbuffer

  • Deferred model render layers: Dg+0x10..0x28 hold 4 layer plugins: 0 OPAQUE_PASS, 1 MASK_PASS (read), 2 DECAL_PASS PluginDeferredGeometryDecal (dev registration; retail Decal Lua create is an obfuscated thunk 0x1401c2ed0), 3 ALPHA_MODEL (dev). Each layer that qualifies at DEFERRED PreExec gets exactly one command-list node, created when its own MainExec calls Dg::SetDeferredModelRenderLayerSubContext 0x14025a6b0 (Opaque/Masked 0x1401c52f0, Decal 0x1401c5290, AlphaModel 0x1401cf6f0). The count per pass is always 1; the only deciding conditions are: layer isActive (+0x50) and vp+0x528 bit at StartDeferredModelRenderJob, the layer plugin's own MainExec running (category/bit/vp-bit18 tests), and a free SubCommandContext.
  • The G-buffer layer nodes are created at their tree positions (stage 1, jobs 1/2/6) but the worker jobs that record them (ModelBuildCommandsJob) are launched only by Dg::FlushDeferredModelRenderSubContextJob from PluginAlphaModel::PostExec 0x1401cf750 (or BypassExec 0x1401cf440 when ALPHA_MODEL is skipped). Layers 0-2 release their packets there; layer 3 keeps its packet and uses the light-search sync Dg+0x70. CPU recording of the opaque/masked G-buffer therefore overlaps everything between DEFERRED and ALPHA_MODEL, while submission order follows the tree.
  • Stage 1 inline node content in recording order: DgDx11::InitViewport clear (vp flags clear mode 7), GLOBAL_VOLUMETRIC_FOG fog-volume atlas (VolFog_TppVolFog), DEFERRED StartDeferredRendering G-buffer ClearRenderBuffer(7), GEOMETRY_PASS StartGeometryPass state. VIEW_CALLBACK, MODEL_SETUP, OCCLUDER and (normally) PRECOMPUTE_SKY add no draws. The first stage-1 job (TERRAIN_DRAW_DEPTH) becomes this node's child; jobs 1..16 follow in its next chain because no inline recording happens between children.
  • Observed stage names: stage 2 inline also holds EndGeometryPass resolves and the velocity-buffer clear (StartGeometryVelocityPass ClearRenderBuffer 1, 0x80800000), not only DownSampleDepth. Stage 3 inline begins with GEOMETRY_PASS's camera-velocity pass before the SSAO plugins.
  • Brief correction: the slot called 'PostExec' at +0x48 runs LAST (after +0x50). For PluginDeferredGeometryOpaque the database names +0x38 'PostExec' and +0x48 'Masked::PreExec' (identical-code folding); plugins.json lists these under PreExec/EndExec. MakeVelocityBuffer is in the +0x48 function 0x1401c54d0 and runs after all GEOMETRY_PASS children.
  • Dg +0x560 in RegisterModelDrawOnJob is reached through thunk_FUN_140204e80 (= dg::GetDgInstance), i.e. always the main DgDx11, so velocity and PluginModel nodes are spawned from the build thread in recording order.
  • Many deferred plugins share the skip test (vp flags bit18 && Render+0xd8 == 2): PluginDeferredRendering, DeferredGeometry, Opaque, Masked, Decal, PluginDecal, RawDecal, MaterialLayer, LightAccumulateLayer, LineIntegralSSAO, Shadow, SphericalHarmonics, Terrain, CloneDeferred, LocalLight, Sunlight, LocalReflection, DeferredShading. No writer of bit18 exists in readable code.

lights shadows

  • Order inside SHADING_PASS: PLUGIN_SPHERICALHARMONICS, LOCAL_LIGHTS, SUN_SHADOW, SUNLIGHT. The CSM is rendered after the local lights and read by the sun light at t3 (ShadowBuffer+0x30).
  • Command tree mechanics: CommandListNode = {next, child}. Branch (current node recorded) makes a child for the job and a continuation sibling; Split (nothing recorded) gives the job the current node and makes a continuation (0x1402c7c50, 0x1402c80b0, used by DgDx11::Branch 0x1402c5220 and CommandBuffer::Branch 0x1402d6f50). State setters do not mark a node as recorded, so consecutive jobs become consecutive siblings, and the last continuation of a worker stays empty.
  • CommandBuffer-level markers in these paths (START_LOCAL_LIGHT, END_LOCAL_LIGHT, NOSHADOW_LIGHTS, NOSHADOW_LIGHTS2, NOSHADOW_POINT_LIGHTS, NOSHADOW_SPOT_LIGHTS, NOSHADOW_DIFFUSEONLY, SHADOW_POINT_LIGHTS, SHADOW_SPOT_LIGHTS, SHADOWMAP, POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWMAP) call identical-code-folded empty stubs in retail. Only Dg+0x290 markers remain: CSM, REFLECTION_MAP, LACCBeginShrinkBuffer, LACCShrinkBufferContinue, LACCEndShrinkBuffer. Dg+0x298 (end) is a stub.
  • ShadowBuffer layout (dev ShadowBuffer::Init 0x1402835c0): +0 DIRECTIONAL_LIGHT_SHADOW, +8 SPOT_LIGHT_SHADOW, +0x10 POINT_LIGHT_SHADOW render buffers; +0x18/+0x24 directional color/depth, +0x1c/+0x28 spot, +0x20/+0x2c point; +0x30 current CSM texture.
  • Shadow map sizes come from LightingShadowMapSettings (g_ShadowMapSettings 0x142b76800, active fields at +0x74 returned by PluginShadow::GetSettings): DirectionalLightShadowResolution (atlas R x R, cascades R/2), SpotLightLightShadowResolution (R x R), PointLightLightShadowResolution (R x R/2, two paraboloid halves), CascadeShadowRangeScale, EnableCascadeShadowBlend; applied in restoreShadowBuffer 0x14027d200. The captures imply 8192 directional and 4096 spot.
  • LightSource flags (light+0x40 -> +0x54): 0x1 enable, 0x2 static, 0x4 clipping bound, 0x10 shadow, 0x20 cascade blend (directional), 0x80 no specular, 0x100 mask, 0x400 distance fade (directional), 0x2000 new attenuation; type at +0x5c (0 directional, 1 point, 2 spot), priority byte at +0x59.
  • DgDx11 stubs that decide branches on D3D11: +0x580 returns 0 (diffuse-only local-light shrink path off), +0x570 returns 0 (RANDOM_PTTERN1 never used), +0x2e0 empty (between PluginShadow caster passes).
  • Mod-inserted compute passes appear inside these nodes (bend_batch_* in the unshadowed node, bend_* in each shadowed light-draw node, gtvbgi_* in stage 9); they are not engine work.
  • Corrections to observed stage names: the stage 7 ambient upsample (BilateralUpscale2x2) is the LACC shrink-buffer end composite recorded from PluginLocalLight::MainExec; stage 8 is PluginShadow (marker CSM), whose 12 jobs are 4 fixed cascades x (opaque, masked, one per terrain object); stage 9 opens with PluginSunlight (REFLECTION_MAP then the sun draw).

post ui

  • Display encode: Render::buildRendering 0x1401beec0 runs list 1 (L118-125) then Dg vt+0x58 DgDx11::EndRender 0x140247ac0 (L129). EndRender (inline, build thread) calls EndRenderBuffer, letterboxes via SetViewportDirect from RenderInfo+0x58/0x5c/0x64/0x66, sets vectors 0x95/0xa5/0xb5 (g_gammaControlParameter), binds GammaControl 0x1FF96E86/0xF781DA25 (handle from SetupShaderResources 0x14024c110, strcode64 0xcd130ed44d9d), t0 = Dg+0x1b0 texture, full-screen draw (L116-119). Dg+0x1b0 is created in DgDx11::Initialize 0x1402ba1b0 with the primary RT handle (Dg+0x1e8) as RenderTargetParameter+0x30, so it is a view of the primary buffer (inferred). Stage 14 = DgDx11::EndViewport 0x140247eb0 (stretch copy only if the viewport has a target; none observed) + list 1 + EndRender.
  • Per-view plugin list = g_renderWork list[Render+0xd8]; Render::Render 0x1401bc2b0 and grx ResetPlugins set 2 (no other writer found). Values 5/6 would force the exposure constant 0x172 to 1.0 (buildRendering L229-235). All ten plugins in this group dereference the viewport, so they must be per-view (list 0/1 run with viewport 0).
  • Stage-13 job slots (7) match per-call spawn counts: OVERLAY_MODEL 1 (target markers, job 0; MainExec = PluginExtendFxModel::MainExec 0x1401e4a20, count inferred), PRIMITIVES_UNFILTERED 2 (PrimitiveRendering::RegisterDrawOnJob +0x560 at 0x14024478d and 0x1402447e9; jobs 1-2), DRAW2D 1 (job 3), PRIMITIVE_DEBUG 2 (jobs 4-5), DRAW2D_FRONTMOST 1 (job 6). Counts read; assignment inferred from order.
  • Stage-12 job slot = DRAW2D_SHRINK's BuildDraw2DJob (only +0x560 site among POSTFILTER children). Its EndShrink composite is a CopyRenderBuffer at the start of stage 13.
  • CopyRenderBuffer accounting: stage 12 = 3 (TONEMAP exposure copy, TONEMAP bloom final copy, DoF scatter scene copy DgResources+0x2c); stage 13 = 3 (DRAW2D_SHRINK composite, motion blur scene copy, motion blur copy-back).
  • Texture slots into the late pass: t6 LUT from COLOR_CORRECTION (DoF composites also bind t6 but run earlier), t7 bloom from TonemapFilterDx11::Draw L632, StartPostFilter BLACK default, TONEMAP EndExec veto. Mod shaders Tonemap 0xE04D1471 / Tonemap_1DLUT declare inImage t0, inColorLUT t6, inBloom t7.
  • StartShrinkBuffer/EndShrinkBuffer markers belong to DgDx11::StartShrinkBuffer 0x1402c1a30 / EndShrinkBuffer 0x1402c1170, called only from PrimitiveRenderingDx11::StartShrinkBuffer 0x140305ba0 / EndShrinkBuffer 0x140303790 (PluginPrimitive half-res path; copy-depth, BilateralUpscale2x2/PointUpscale). They are not part of this group.
  • 'Downsample Color Buffer' marker has two owners: Draw2DRenderingDx11::DownsampleColorBuffer 0x1402e6920 (DRAW2D_SHRINK only) and PrimitiveRenderingDx11::DownsampleColorBuffer 0x1403030b0.
  • grx PluginSettings flags (data+0xac): bit0 isTonemap, 1 isBloom, 2 isMotionBlur, 3 isDepthOfField, 4 isDOFVisualizeFocus, 5 isLocalReflections, 6 isTemporalAA, 7 isFixedShutterRatio, 8 isPatchVelocity, 9 isLightAdaptationFromLACC, 10 isShowDecals, 11 isShrinkSHBuffer (OnSet 0x141c55510 case order; usage in Update 0x141c57310 confirms bits 0-3,7-10).
  • Graphics settings tables: 'PluginToneMap'{EnableBloom}, 'PluginFxaa'{EnableFilter}, 'PluginMotionBlur'{EnableFilter, BaseAmount}, 'MotionBlurAmount'{BlurAmount}, DOF{EnableFilter, QualityType}; applied value = settings+0x64 (+0x6c.. for DOF, +0xb4.. for motion blur). The level key is GraphicsSettingDesc+0x70 (likely PostProcessQuality, inferred); user options DepthOfField Disable/Enable and MotionBlurAmount Off/Small/Medium/Large (GraphicsSettingSource 0x1409477e0 / 0x140947ac0).
  • Corrections to brief data: plugins.json lacks PluginPostFilter (vtable 0x1420f9680) and its DB method names are shifted by slot; plugins.json slot names are by slot but some DB names on those addresses are wrong (e.g. MotionBlur 0x1401e2df0 'EndResource' is InitResource). CopyReductionX2 has no code reference (render-map.html calls it a supported branch).
  • No pause- or menu-specific test exists in this group's code. The ACC (menu) capture took the same branches as Hillside; it only lacked target-marker and most HUD draws.
  • native arrays list PS hash then VS hash.

terrain decals clones

  • Stage-1 job slots (GEOMETRY_PASS children in priority order) by spawn site. 0 TERRAIN_DRAW_DEPTH TerrainRendering::DrawOnJob 0x140273340 (DrawType 2). 1 OPAQUE_PASS and 2 MASK_PASS (other group). 3 DEFERRED_CLONE PluginClone::MainExec 0x140206630, first spawn (CLONE). 4 same, second spawn (CLONEDS). 5 TERRAIN_DRAW DrawOnJob 0x140273340 (DrawType 1). 6 DECAL_PASS Dg::SetDeferredModelRenderLayerSubContext 0x14025a6b0. 7-12 DECALS_DEFERRED DecalRendering::RegisterDrawOnJob 0x140272390, six times (group 0/1/2 x material flag 0/1). 13 DECALS_DEFERRED TerrainDecalDrawOnJob 0x140275280. 14 DECALS_DEFERRED RegisterModelDecalDrawOnJob 0x140272760. 15 DEFERRED_CLONEDECAL PluginClone::MainExec 0x140206630 (DecalType != 0). 16 DEFERRED_RAWDECAL RawDecalRendering::RegisterDrawOnJob 0x1402761a0. MATERIAL_LAYER spawns no job. Total 17, matching the observed nodes 2-18.
  • No other candidate fills the empty slots. PluginCloneWireframe is not in the instance tree. TerrainDraw2 overlay wire (DrawType 5) needs TerrainDraw2+0x98, which only the constructor writes (to 0). Legacy TERRAIN_DRAW objects would add nodes inside slots 0 and 5, but their shaders (TerrainDraw_4Materials, TerrainDepth, TerrainShadow, TerrainHole, TerrainSelfShadow, TerrainPseudo, plus _Block/_ln) are absent from the shader catalog.
  • Each node inherits the build-thread state at spawn time: DgDx11::Branch 0x1402c5220 lines 58-81 copy the view/projection constants, ShaderTechniqueManager shader-select index and default shader, and duplicate the ShadowConstantRegister/RenderStateContext/RenderResourceContext. The inline StartDraw/StartDecal/StartGeometryDecalPass/StartDeferredCloneObject calls therefore configure the following job nodes without recording anything themselves; the observed tree has no inline node between the stage-1 jobs.
  • Terrain camera culling and LOD are computed only once, in TERRAIN_DRAW_DEPTH: VisibilityTestOnJob writes terrain+0xf0, LodCalculationOnJob writes terrain+0xf8 and EnumerateHoles writes terrain+0xe8. TERRAIN_DRAW (list 2), the terrain decals and the sun-shadow pass reuse them. If TERRAIN_DRAW_DEPTH were disabled, TERRAIN_DRAW would draw from stale results. In stage 1 Hillside, depth draws 565 = material draws 559+6.
  • Terrain shadow-map draws: PluginShadow::MainExec 0x1401eb190 (SUN_SHADOW) loops over 4 cascades (line 4081). For each cascade it spawns two model-shadow nodes (Dg+0x560 at lines 3614 and 3626, then model rendering +0x38 at line 3636), then calls TerrainRendering +0x30 StartShadow 0x140296cc0 inline (SetVector 0xb5=0, depth bits 0x1f, cull field set to 4, backend +8 bit 0). Legacy TerrainDraw objects get VisibilityTestOnJob +0xe0 and DrawOnJob +0xf0 with DrawType 3 (lines 3860-3863). Each TerrainDraw2 gets VisibilityTestOnJob +0xd8 (light frustum) and DrawOnJob +0xe8 0x140273340 with DrawType 3 (lines 4038-4041), which is the third node per cascade. EndShadow +0x38 0x140292d10 runs inline. The shader is NewTerrain_Shadow PS 0xD68FF97A / VS 0xD0B08992 at DgResources +0x44, set in TerrainDrawWork case 3 (_ln: PS 0xEAF0D644 / VS 0x1463BCD2). No LOD or holes job runs in the shadow pass, so the cascades reuse the camera LOD and holes from TERRAIN_DRAW_DEPTH.
  • Terrain self-shadow and the TERRAIN_SHADOW marker belong only to PluginSelfShadowOfTerrain, which handles legacy TerrainDraw objects only. That plugin is absent from the instance tree, and NewTerrain_SelfShadow (0xB45DF15A) is never bound by any retail code, so terrain self-shadow is effectively dead in TPP.
  • PerformanceEventBegin (Dg +0x290 = 0x14024a460), in both the dev and retail builds, only converts the name to wide chars and frees the buffer; +0x298 is an empty stub. No marker (plugin names, TERRAIN_SHADOW, 'Draw MaterialLayer') reaches the D3D command stream.
  • The gn device-context vtable offsets used for recording are inferred from their arguments: +0x90 (0,1,...) IASetVertexBuffers, +0x98 (buffer, 0x39 = DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UINT) IASetIndexBuffer, +0x60 DrawIndexed, +0xa0 DrawIndexedInstanced, +0xc0(4) primitive topology.
  • Code confirms three instance names (TERRAIN_DRAW, DECALS_DEFERRED, MATERIAL_LAYER). The rest come from the historical Frida list.
  • Observation caveat: the stage-1 terrain material and terrain decal entries list every port VS hash with an identical count (565 and 295), including _ln VS variants whose PS never ran. The PS hashes are the reliable variant indicator (non-_ln in both captures).

tpp effects

  • Five ways the game layer reaches the engine, all read in code: (1) SceneObjects queued in the default Scene: fox::gr::Primitive::Create 0x1401e79e0 makes a PRIMITIVES-type object unless PrimitiveDesc+4 has 0x100000 (PRIMITIVES_UNFILTERED type); fox::gr::Draw2D::Draw2D 0x1401bfca0 / 0x1401bfc10 picks DRAW2D_FRONTMOST for flags&1, DRAW2D_SHRINK (Plugin2DShrink, a POSTFILTER child) for flags&2, else DRAW2D. (2) User-material overrides inside engine plugins: Viewport+0x568 replaces the deferred composition shader (DgDx11::StartDeferredShading 0x1402c03a0 lines 92-98), SkyDrawContext+0x130 replaces the sky shader (SkyRenderingDx11::Draw 0x140306d10 lines 103-115), PluginGlobalVolumetricFog+0x70 carries the TPP fog material. (3) fox::gr::PluginMaterialLayer::Regist (rain G-buffer layer). (4) Separate views via fox::gr::Render::AddViewport: TppRainFilterDepthCapture, OceanWaveViewport, WaterRippleViewport*, SubViewportMirror*, TppCigaretteSmoke, SubViewportAvatarPhoto*, GrTextureBlender, cutscene CurtainShadow/ReflectionDemoCamera views. (5) Direct writes on plugin instances through RenderPlugin::GetPlugin(StrCode64 name) and RenderPlugin::SetActivity.
  • Every game-effect primitive checked in this group (water, laser, IR line, smoke, throw arc, sonar, mirror, footprints, dust, fire lights, sand wind, heat haze, sky clouds, stars) has PrimitiveDesc+4 without 0x100000, so all of them draw in PRIMITIVES, none in PRIMITIVES_UNFILTERED.
  • PRIMITIVES records into two command sub-contexts: fox::gr::dg::plugins::PrimitiveRendering::RegisterDrawOnJob 0x1402446b0 calls Dg +0x560 at lines 59 and 71; between them it calls its own vt +0x40 PrimitiveRenderingDx11::DownsampleColorBuffer 0x1403030b0 (marker 'Downsample Color Buffer', when param_5 bit 0 and the resolve flag) and vt +0x48 StartShrinkBuffer 0x140305ba0 (when shrink level > 0), and vt +0x50 EndShrinkBuffer 0x140303790 right after the second spawn (dg-plugins.json PrimitiveRenderingDx11 slots 8-10). Sub-context 1 is the observed stage 10 job 0 (child of LOCAL_REFLECTION's inline node) and sub-context 2 is stage 11 job 0, so the same primitive shader can appear in both. Correction to the stage names: stage 10 job 0 is 'PRIMITIVES sub-context 1', not specifically lit particles (part-misc LaserSight entry).
  • Stage 11 job 1 is the THERMOGRAPHY plugin drawing collectible-indication thermography models (TppThermographyCollectible / TppThermographyGrass), not generic 'thermography markers'; plain TppThermography only fades in with night vision (part-filters).
  • 'NoIR' in TppRainFilterGBufferMaterial_NoIR and DR_TonemapRainFilter_NoIR means no rain-interrupt (shelter) volume near the camera (TppRainFilterInterruptManager+0x3524 == 0), not infrared. Night vision never switches to a dedicated shader: it changes the COLOR_CORRECTION LUT slot 4, TonemapValueHolder slot 1 (DR composition parameter), exposure, fog lower bound and enables the THERMOGRAPHY viewport parameter (part-filters).
  • Weather: rain filter and fall-rain fx turn on at WeatherDesc+0xed8 >= 0.4 (WeatherClimateUpdator::Update 0x1406b96e0 lines 363-367, WeatherRain::Update 0x14072dde0); weather type numbering Clear 0, Cloudy 1, Rainy 2, Sandstorm 3, Foggy 4 (TppLightFileConverter keyword parser, part-misc); sandstorm runs when the current or next type is 3.
  • The effect cut-level system is inert in retail: CutLevelController::Update 0x1406feef0 writes 0 every frame, so SystemImpl::Update keeps MOTION_BLUR and FXAA active and every cut-level fade at full quality.
  • Capture state implied by the observed shaders: TPP tonemap enabled (DR_VolFog_TppTonemap), no rain filter, TPP fog on with distance >= 5000 m, baked sky (Sky_Draw_TppBaked), no TPP clouds, fx particles on their _VF variants (scene volumetric fog on) and Hillside on EffectSetting+0x1c == 2 (_VF_EX), Hillside river with ripple texture (Prim_TppRiverModelShHnmRpl), collectible indication on in Hillside.
  • Shaders in this group's scope that ran in neither capture include every DR_TonemapRainFilter*/TppRainFilter* and depth-capture shader, DR_VolFog_TppTonemap_MD, Sky_Draw_Tpp/TppNoSky, all Prim_TppSkyCld3*, all ocean/marsh shaders, all river variants except ShHnmRpl, TppThermography, all Draw2D_Tpp* filters, the wormhole and sand-wind shaders, droplets, heat haze, cigarette, throwing, sonar, foot shadow, mirror, footprint, dust, fire lights, skidmarks and video.
  • Plugin category numbers (Viewport::SetPluginCategoryEnable 0-6, plugin +0x4c/+0x48 bit) come from the settings data; no part of this group maps them to plugin instances.
  • func-shaders.json false positives in this scope: 'Clear' in TppLightFileConverter is a weather keyword, 'ColorCorrection' in fox::grx::ColorCorrection::RegisterEntity is an entity name, and the GkFxVectorJobInit g_fstr_* entries are string-handle initializers (the TppRainFilterDepthCapture handle names the depth-capture Scene).
  • [filters] Draw2D routing (read): fox::gr::Draw2D::Create(out, priority, flags) 0x1401c0190 and the Draw2DDesc ctor 0x1401bfc10 pick the scene-object type: flags&1 -> Draw2DFrontmostTypeNumber (DRAW2D_FRONTMOST), else flags&2 -> Draw2DShrinkTypeNumber (DRAW2D_SHRINK, POSTFILTER child), else Draw2DTypeNumber (DRAW2D). Plugin2D/Plugin2DFrontmost/Plugin2DShrink::GetTargetSceneObjectTypeNumber 0x1401c0a40/50/60.
  • [filters] Every tpp::ef screen filter except DropletsFilter is a flags-0 Draw2D (DRAW2D, stage 13 job 3, after FXAA and post-tonemap); most resolve a back-buffer copy (Draw2D::SetResolveBackBuffer), so they read the already graded/tonemapped LDR image.
  • [filters] DropletsFilter is the only game filter on DRAW2D_SHRINK (desc flags 2), i.e. inside POSTFILTER between DEPTH_OF_FIELD and MOTION_BLUR - before late tonemap/color grading.
  • [filters] SandWind and HeatHaze are regular primitives (PrimitiveDesc flags 0x2802, no 0x100000) sampling GBUFFER_NORMAL (and GBUFFER_SPECULAR / back-buffer) -> PRIMITIVES.
  • [filters] Night vision is not a shader path: it is a ColorCorrectionController LUT (slot 4), TonemapValueHolder slot 1 (DR_VolFog_TppTonemap parameter), exposure and fog lower-bound changes, plus enabling the THERMOGRAPHY viewport parameter (type 2). Rain 'NoIR' = no rain interrupt volume, unrelated to NVG.
  • [filters] Hillside's THERMOGRAPHY job (stage 11 job 1) is collectible indication (CollectibleIndicationFilter -> NightVisionManager::CollectibleIndicationOn), not NVG; that is why only TppThermographyCollectible/Grass ran.
  • [filters] Weather type enum observed in code: 2 = rain (TppRainFilterBody), 3 = sandstorm (WeatherSandStorm::Update 0x1407058a0 dev line 72).
  • [water] All water surfaces are regular fox::gr::Primitive objects queued in the default scene: none sets PrimitiveDesc flag 0x100000, so all draw through PRIMITIVES, not PRIMITIVES_UNFILTERED (fox::gr::Primitive::Create 0x1401e79e0). Rivers and the 24-hour ocean bind Texture::CreateTextureFromBackBuffer as a refraction input, matching the observed river draw at stage 11 job 0 (after the scene copy). The Fourier ocean does not: FourierOceanManager::Initialize 0x1406fbb60 binds six textures of its own, its shaders declare no screen texture, and it draws in pass A before the scene copy exists (corrected 2026-11-19).
  • [water] TppWaterBounding (0x1406ecd60..0x1406eeb00) only answers water-level / in-volume queries; it has no rendering.
  • [water] Fourier LQ/HQ is a clipmap ring split (outer two rings LQ), not a graphics quality option.
  • [water] Fourier and 24h oceans are independent entity types (TppFourierOcean vs TppOcean); which one a location uses is level data.
  • [water] FourierOceanManager::UpdateMaterial passes TonemapValueHolder::GetShaderParameter into ocean material param 4 when the TPP tonemap is enabled, so ocean shaders receive the same game tonemap parameters as DR_VolFog_TppTonemap.
  • [atmo] tpp ShaderPoolManager slots read in this scope: 20-27 clouds (SkyClouds3Ctrl::BindShader 0x140730f00), 34/35 SSky (TppConstantSkyMaterial 0x1407964a0), 43 VolFog_TppVolFog (VolumetricFogDrawer::Update 0x1407a0490), 44/45/46 Sky_Draw_* (SkyDrawer::Update 0x1407cb350); each falls back to pool+0x30 if the pool is short.
  • [atmo] Sky and fog use the same override pattern as the deferred composition: the engine plugin draws its own shader unless a game user Material is set (SkyDrawContext+0x130 for SKY, PluginGlobalVolumetricFog+0x70 for fog, Viewport+0x568 for composition).
  • [atmo] TppAtmosphere localFlags (+0x298) bits from TppAtmospherePropertyHandler::OnGet 0x14076ff60 (names matched by StrCode64): 1 enable, 2 skyEnable, 3 sunLightEnable, 4 castShadow, 5 skyLightEnable, 6 usePrecomputedAmbient, 7 isCascadeBlend, 8 disableSkyCapture, 9 dirLightFade, 11 isSteppedMoveOfDirectionalLight, 0x7000 useBakedData, 31 expandHorizontalLineColor.
  • [atmo] The TPP tonemap (TonemapValueHolder) is a game-side highlight compression baked into many scene materials before the engine's late TONEMAP; no link to the engine TONEMAP plugin found.
  • [atmo] Captures: baked sky, TPP fog on with distance >= 5000 m, TPP tonemap enabled, no clouds, no sky precompute pass.
  • [misc] PluginPrimitive Lua settings per instance (ctor 0x1401e73a0 dev): shrinkLevel -> +0x74/+0x75, shrinkFilter -> +0x76, isEnableResolveRenderBuffer -> +0x70 bit0 (default 1). PluginPrimitive::MainExec passes +0x70 and +0x75 to PrimitiveRendering::RegisterDrawOnJob.
  • [misc] RegisterDrawOnJob 0x1402446b0 calls Dg +0x560 twice: sub-context 1 (packet+0x120) before anything else, then inline DownsampleColorBuffer (vtable +0x40, marker "Downsample Color Buffer") when +0x70 bit0, StartShrinkBuffer (+0x48) when shrinkLevel>0, sub-context 2 (packet+0x128), EndShrinkBuffer (+0x50). BuildCommands 0x1403022e0 draws the first packet group into sub-context 1 and the last group (count at params+0x14) into sub-context 2 after StartShrinkBuffer. This explains one primitive shader appearing as stage 10 job 0 (sub-context 1, child of the LOCAL_REFLECTION inline node) and stage 11 job 0 (sub-context 2, after the scene-copy inline recording). The packet split criterion is set in BuildMacroPacketPhaseWork::SetupPrimitiveObject 0x140304890 and was not decoded.
  • [misc] Observed stage name correction: stage 10 job 0 is the first PRIMITIVES sub-context (not specifically "lit particles"); stage 11 inline is PrimitiveRenderingDx11::DownsampleColorBuffer 0x1403030b0 (scene copy) plus shrink-buffer start.
  • [misc] No PrimitiveDesc flag seen in this group sets 0x100000, so none of these effects use PRIMITIVES_UNFILTERED.
  • [misc] g_fstr_Draw2D_Border 0x141fe6e10/0x141fe6e40 and g_fstr_TppRainFilterDepthCapture 0x141ff0d40/0x141ff23d0 are static FString initializers (GetBinaryStringHandle) mislabelled to GkFxVectorJobInit.obj by folding; they store handles in DAT_142baabd8 / DAT_142be1988 and draw nothing themselves. DAT_142be1988 (TppRainFilterDepthCapture) is read by tpp::ef::impl::TextureDrawer::TextureDrawer (rain interrupt texture drawer, parent scope); no reader of DAT_142baabd8 found by code_search.
  • [misc] Weather enum from the light-file parser (0x1407c9230 dev): Clear=0, Cloudy=1, Rainy=2, SandStom=3, Foggy=4 - matches TppRainFilterBody::SetWeatherType using 2 for rain.
